other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Fifty one weeks imprisonment and/or fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and/or fine.

If the offence is committed before the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the penalty is three months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

Time limit for prosecutions:
none

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
